# Kit 8: courtyard stone + wooden climb props (build notes)

**Sheet:** `References/Dojo/dojo_courtyard_stone_ref.png` (AI-generated by the user with ChatGPT, modelling reference only;
see REFERENCE_LOG.md). **Look target:** `dojo1_reference2.png` (sunset). **Specs:** DOJO_ARENA_SPEC.md (4.3, 5.1, 5.3, R3,
R8), STYLE_GUIDE.md (3, 5, 6, 10). Blender only; no Unreal in this run.

## 2026-09-27: BUILD stage

### Files (all owned by this stage)
| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Textures (numpy, procedural, own) | `Scripts/dojo/props/stone/make_stone_textures.py` -> `Exports/DojoKit/Props/stone/Textures/T_DKP_Stone_<Set>_{BC,N,ORM}.png` (N DirectX) |
| Geometry helpers | `Scripts/dojo/props/stone/stone_geo.py` (Part builder: UV0 rules, UV1 lightmap pack, convex UCX) |

### QA and export
- `qa_check(require_uv1=True)`: **0 hard fails on all 12**. Waived by design (as in the armory kit): `uv_no_overlap` on
  UV0 for every piece (tiling materials) and `uv0_tile_range` on the rope (U runs along its 0.83 m length). UV1 is
  Blender's lightmap pack (inside 0-1, no overlap; checked by the gate).
- 12 FBX exported through `pipeline.export_fbx(kind="static")`, no warnings. Each FBX carries its mesh plus its UCX
  children (UCX_<node name>_NN).
- No LODs yet (Nanite candidates; the style guide asks LOD0-2 for shipping): open.

### Open after this stage
- The sheet's stone is darker, bluer and more deeply tooled with lichen and moss tufts on every ledge; ours is still
  lighter and smoother up close. Moss clumps on the tier ledges and at the ground are not modelled (texture trim only).
- The sheet's timber is darker with deeper silver-grey weathering; ours reads cleaner and browner.
- The sunset sky in the line-up is a flat peach (the world gradient did not take); the lighting itself is right.
- No LODs; the rope UCX exists only for the pipeline gate (set NoCollision in Unreal).
- A stray `C:\WorkFiles\` folder exists on the drive root (Blender writes relative render paths there). This stage's
  own stray output was moved back and removed; `C:\WorkFiles\dojo\build\props\training`, `armory`, `fan` belong to other
  chats and were not touched.

### Judge blockers and deltas
- **Lantern cap (blocker)**: rebuilt (`kasa()`): a 7 cm eave band (4.9 cm on the short lantern), corners that curl up 7.5 cm and flare 3 cm into thick tips, a concave roof from about 25 to 55 degrees, four raised hip ridges (5.6-6.4 cm wide, 4.4-6 cm proud) from the tips to a two-step square collar, a round collar ring and the plain ball. The top view shows the X of ridges converging on the ball. Cap / base width measured on the front renders by the same method: ours **1.53**, the sheet **1.52** (r0 1.58). Rise (eave bottom to roof top) 0.36 m; the sheet is about 0.37 m at our scale.
- **Stone surface (blocker)**: new granite: two scales of tilted flakes (warped periodic Voronoi, 4 and 1.8 cm), block-scale lumps, jagged fissures (zero crossings of band-limited noise), hammer pits, cavity darkening, crystals, lichen gathering in the recesses; normal tilt mean 13 deg / p95 36 deg (r0 was a smooth marbled noise). Tier arrises are chipped in geometry (`rough_tier`: chamfer rings jittered up to 1 cm). Well blocks: pillowed rough-faced ashlar (5 x 5 outer grid, border set back 1.4 cm, bulge 1.4-2.2 cm with jitter), course heights 19-21 cm, 13 / 14 blocks per course with lengths varied 0.78-1.3 x, 1.2 cm joints over a dark mortar core.
- **Moss**: new `T_DKP_Stone_GraniteLedge` (granite + olive moss clumps) on every up-facing face of the plinth steps, tiers, collars and cap (`up_mat`), plus the ground trim.
- **Well roofs**: both use a new silver-grey `T_DKP_Stone_TimberGrey` (the roofs on the sheet are grey). Plank roof: 3.5-4.3 cm boards of irregular width, length, tilt and yaw, alternately lapped high, a fascia along each eave, rafters on two purlins a side, ridge boards. Gable: separate thick boards with 1.6 cm gaps and staggered lengths, a ridge board, four rafters and a purlin a side (the underside is no longer bare).
- **Cover crossbeam**: 13 x 13 cm, spans X +-0.62 to butt against the posts of either frame (inner faces at 0.62 on both), iron U-straps with bolts at each end; the rope now ties round it in two tight turns (no loose coil).
- **Pulley**: 32-segment sheave, bevelled rims, dished sides, a round groove (103 mm), smooth normals except on the flat faces, hub boss, iron pin with caps, a yoke of two wooden cheek blocks and an iron head plate bolted under the tie beam. The axle moved 1.56 -> **1.54** so the rope clears the head plate (yoke top at +1.70 = the tie-beam underside on both frames).
- **Bucket**: 20 staves, bevelled rim, two iron hoops, two wooden lugs carrying the bail on pinned iron heads.
- **Cistern**: posts stand **3.5 cm proud** of the boards from foot to lid; granite feet 0.20 x 0.20 m (2 x the 0.10 post); boards of uneven width with gaps over a dark liner; rails nailed to every board; bands stepped round the posts; a lid of 4.5 cm planks over a 3.5 cm rim, overhanging the boards 5.5 cm; two **7.5 x 7 cm cleats** standing proud and overhanging the front and back edge by 3.5 cm. Collision stays the 1.20 x 1.20 box with a flat top at +1.25 = the plank tops (R3, depth 1.20).
- **Crates**: the weathered cistern timber, uneven board heights with gaps over a dark liner, and two 9 x 6 cm skids with the body raised on them. Collision unchanged (1.00 x 1.00, top +1.25 / +0.625).
- **Wood surface**: timber texture rebuilt (grain lines bent round 14 knots, sharp dark latewood, silver weathering on the raised grain, long splits and checks, stains).
- Glow amber deepened: rendered window pixels (238, 191, 155) against the sheet (229, 190, 139); r0 was (237, 201, 168).
- Line-up sky gradient fixed (the r0 ramp ran to z 0.35 while the camera sees z 0-0.3).
- Side-by-sides: the reference crop is now upscaled to our sheet height first, so small props (bucket, pulley) are no longer shrunk to a 90 px crop.

- `bake_wear` on every piece (Wear corner colours). Timber assemblies bake occlusion within 6 cm (the 15 cm default
  gave the stacked well roof R 0.98 on whole members); stone keeps 15 cm. The well blocks get a per-block grime offset
  (R + 0..0.30) so neighbouring stones differ under the continuous triplanar granite.
- New `timber_bands.py`: the library timber tile has strong tone bands across the grain (only 6 % of its rows lie within
  +-12 % of the median tone), and grain_uv's random V offsets put one board in the darkest band and its neighbour in the
  lightest (r2 first renders: near-black next to orange). Each member's V is moved to the nearest mid-tone row; U, the
  end grain, the textures and the library are untouched. Mean shift 0.06-0.12 tile.
- Superseded T_DKP_Stone_{Granite, GraniteMoss, GraniteLedge, Timber, TimberGrey, Iron, Rope, LanternGlow}_* stay in
  Textures/ (the showcase's earlier import references them); no FBX uses them now.
